channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Police contact royal bodyguards in probe of former Prince Andrew
item.description: LONDON >> British police today said they were contacting royal protection officers who might have information about Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, the former prince, a day after his stunning arrest amid scrutiny over his links to disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Judge upholds $243M verdict against Tesla over fatal Autopilot crash
item.description: A federal judge rejected Tesla’s request to overturn a $243 million jury verdict over the 2019 crash of an Autopilot-equipped Model S, which killed a 22-year-old woman and severely injured her boyfriend.

item.title: Wall Street ends higher after Supreme Court rules against tariffs
item.description: U.S. stocks ended higher to, led by gains in Alphabet, Amazon and other Wall Street heavyweights after the Supreme Court struck down President Donald Trump’s global tariffs.

item.title: Abandoned baby monkey finds comfort in stuffed orangutan in Japan
item.description: ICHIKAWA, Japan >> At a zoo outside Tokyo, the monkey enclosure has become a must-see attraction thanks to an inseparable pair: Punch, a baby Japanese macaque, and his stuffed orangutan companion. Punch’s mother abandoned the macaque when he was born seven months ago at the Ichikawa City Zoo and when an onlooker noticed and alerted zookeepers, they swung into action.

item.title: Honolulu police open arson case in Diamond Head house fire
item.description: Honolulu police have opened an arson investigation after an early-morning fire Wednesday severely damaged a Diamond Head home.

item.title: MAHA activists warn Trump could lose their support over glyphosate
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Members of the U.S. Make America Healthy Again movement that backs Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. say an executive order this week to boost domestic production of the weedkiller glyphosate risks their support in November’s midterm elections.

item.title: Saks Global gets final court approval for $1 billion bankruptcy loan
item.description: A U.S. bankruptcy judge today gave final approval to Saks Global’s bankruptcy financing, which provides $1 billion in new funding to the company, after Saks reached deals with luxury brand vendors that had raised concerns about getting paid for goods shipped to the retailer before it went bankrupt.

item.title: Man, 70, in critical condition after being pulled from ocean off Waikiki
item.description: A 70-year-old man was in critical condition after being pulled from the ocean at Duke Kahanamoku Beach in Waikiki this morning.

item.title: Shark warning signs posted at Makaha Beach Park
item.description: Warning signs have been posted at Makaha Beach Park after city lifeguards spotted an aggressive shark this afternoon.

item.title: Man, 19, charged in Kapolei shooting of mainland contractors
item.description: A 19-year-old man was charged today with attempted murder and firearm offenses after he allegedly shot two contract workers from the mainland in front of a Taco Bell in Kapolei Sunday night.
